messages:
Jorge (eng-oncall): incident-bot alerted: spike in client 502s and streaming disconnects after SDK 3.5 rollout to canary 
incident-bot: SEV2 - elevated error rate on /v1/stream endpoint (since 2160002400). Trigger: 502s + heartbeat disconnects.
Jorge (eng-oncall): I'm seeing the same in traces — handshake failures when clients try to resume paging with KV-cache.
Maya (frontend): Customer Report: AcmePay is seeing aborted payment flows, ~15% of sessions failing with stream reset. They just updated SDK to 3.5 this morning.
Priya (support): We got a high-priority ticket from AcmePay, they've rolled back on their side but want root cause and ETA.
Sam (sdk): Pushed SDK 3.5 earlier; main change was the paging header rename and a small handshake tweak for streaming resumption. Had unit tests but not full integration with streaming proxies.
Elaine (sre): Can you confirm the header rename? Which header?
Sam (sdk): We renamed `X-Redwood-Paging` -> `X-RW-Paging` to make header shorter. Server still checks `X-Redwood-Paging` in a compatibility path, but canary routing to new infra missed the shim.
Jorge (eng-oncall): That matches. Canary hosts 3a and 3b are on a new runtime patch that doesn't have the compatibility shim. Traffic split was 10% -> we see errors from those hosts.
Maya (frontend): So clients that got routed to new canary PRs break streaming handshake -> clients either get 502 or a truncated streaming frame.
Priya (support): Which customers affected? I can correlate tickets: AcmePay, Checkoutly, and two smaller partners.
Incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled. Current owner: Jorge. Handoff to Elaine in 20m if not resolved.
Jorge (eng-oncall): Action plan: 1) flip kill-switch (feature flag) to stop SDK 3.5 feature propagation, 2) push emergency rollback for canary hosts to previous runtime shim, or 3) ask infra to re-enable header compatibility shim. Which is fastest?
Elaine (sre): Kill-switch first. Where is the flag?
Sam (sdk): It's a server-side rollout flag: `sdk_paging_header_shortname_enabled`. I can flip it via console but need deploy-bot approval for immediate env override.
deploy-bot: Approval required from eng-oncall or SRE to override production rollout flag.
Jorge (eng-oncall): I approve. Flip it now, Sam.
Sam (sdk): Flipping `sdk_paging_header_shortname_enabled=false` now.
Maya (frontend): Confirming: telemetry shows drop in new error traces from 18 hosts -> decreasing 502 rate within 60s.
Priya (support): AcmePay reports error rate dropping, they re-enabled traffic and saw successful flows. They want a postmortem and timeline.
Jorge (eng-oncall): Good. Next: roll back canary hosts that got the new runtime. Elaine, can you coordinate with infra to push rollback if kill-switch doesn't fully mitigate?
Elaine (sre): On it. I see 3a still spiking slightly — probably sticky connections. I'll evict those nodes from LB and trigger rollback 2160002600.
Sam (sdk): I'll prepare a minimal patch to restore header compatibility in the runtime for a forward fix, then ship a proper SDK 3.5.1 with tests to ensure runtime shim detection.
Maya (frontend): Quick note: client-side SDK has a short-circuit fallback but it's only for non-streaming flows. We should add a streaming handshake fallback as part of the patch.
Priya (support): Customer comms draft: "We're investigating an SDK/infra compatibility issue affecting streaming payments for customers on SDK 3.5. We've applied a temporary server-side mitigation and are rolling back canary hosts where needed. We'll follow up with a timeline and postmortem." Approve?
Jorge (eng-oncall): Approve. Add estimated ETA for full rollback completion: +20 minutes.
Incident-bot: SEV2 -> Mitigated by flag flip. Monitoring for 30m.
Elaine (sre): Rollback in progress for 3a/3b. LB drain started.
Sam (sdk): Creating a PR for 3.5.1 to restore compatibility shim + add integration test against stream proxy. Link: https://git.redwood/sdks/rdw-sdk/pulls/876
Maya (frontend): I'm running a smoke load against canary endpoints to validate handshake recovery.
Priya (support): AcmePay: "Thanks, we see flows recover. Please keep us posted about fix timeline"
Jorge (eng-oncall): Handing off to Elaine; I'm going offline for another pager. Elaine owning for next 3 hours.
Elaine (sre): Acknowledged, owning. If rollback completes we will monitor 15m then close incident.
Incident-bot: oncall handoff recorded. New owner: Elaine.
Elaine (sre): Postmortem notes to capture: - Missing compatibility shim on new runtime hosts - Header rename in SDK without canary runtime detection - Lack of streaming handshake integration test - Action items: add streaming handshake test, require runtime-proxy contract test in release checklist, tag SDK releases with server-compat matrix.
Sam (sdk): I'll write the SDK-side changelog and bump to 3.5.1. Also will open an RFC for header deprecation schedule and a migration plan to avoid name collisions.
Maya (frontend): Recommend immediate addition of an automated smoke test that spins up a real streaming proxy and validates resumption with new SDK versions during canary.
Priya (support): I'll send customer follow-up to affected customers with mitigation summary and targeted ETA for patch: "We expect a patch release in ~4 hours, hotfix 3.5.1 and runtime shim re-enable within that window."
Elaine (sre): Monitoring shows error rate back to baseline. Setting incident status: mitigated -> starting postmortem.
Jorge (eng-oncall): Thanks team. We'll keep the thread for postmortem notes and action item assignments.
